title: Blue Poison Dart Frog
description: A vibrant blue poison dart frog with bold yellow and black markings sits on a colorful leaf in the center of the frame. The frog is surrounded by dark, wet jungle foliage, cracked earth, glowing orange flowers, and dramatic beams of light filtering through the canopy.
prompt: A highly detailed digital painting of a vibrant blue poison dart frog with intricate yellow and black patterns, perched on a multicolored leaf in a dark tropical rainforest. The ground is cracked dry earth with glowing orange flowers and wet foliage around it. Dramatic god rays shine down through the dense canopy, creating a mystical atmosphere with rich textures and realistic details.
